_notes: Known residual failures are upstream RustCFML engine bugs; each entry in failing[] should map to an open issue on https://github.com/RustCFML/RustCFML. There are none at v0.637.0.

migrationSpec 'creates an index on multiple columns' was previously listed here against RustCFML/RustCFML#377 (QoQ recordCount corruption). That attribution was wrong: #377 was closed unable-to-reproduce, and the failure was a Wheels assertion that assumed one comma-delimited cfdbinfo row on RustCFML, which returns one row per column. Fixed in the spec (wheels-dev/wheels#3686).

Earlier tracked bugs now fixed framework-side or upstream were: #376 Hash(binary), #378 java.io.File two-arg constructor, #379 void-assignment key deletion, #380 GetTempDirectory separator, #381 new-operator name lowercasing.
